subject: Business Models
title: Affiliate Revenue
description: A micro-lesson that makes Affiliate Revenue usable.

hook.text: A blog recommends a product. You click the link and buy it. The blogger earns 5-15% commission.

buildup.text: Amazon Associates alone pays influencers billions annually. Every product link is a potential commission.

discovery.text: Wirecutter built a $30 million business entirely on affiliate links before the NYT acquired it.

twist.text: Trust is fragile. One biased recommendation erodes credibility and collapses the entire model.

climax.text: Affiliate revenue aligns incentives: the recommender earns only when the customer finds value.

punchline.text: Recommend, earn, repeat. Trust is the affiliate's only asset.

quiz.question: What destroyed the credibility of some affiliate marketers?

details.summary: Affiliate revenue comes from earning commissions by referring customers to another company's products or services. Bloggers, comparison sites, and influencers embed tracked links and earn a percentage of resulting sales..
details.whyItMatters: Affiliate marketing is a multi-billion dollar industry that monetizes attention and trust without requiring product creation..
takeaways: Publishers earn commissions by driving sales through tracked referral links
Amazon, ShareASale, and CJ Affiliate are the largest affiliate networks
Commission rates range from 1% for electronics to 50% for digital products

faq.question: How do affiliate commissions work in practice?
faq.answer: A publisher embeds a unique tracking link in their content. When a reader clicks and makes a purchase, the affiliate network attributes the sale and pays the publisher a commission. Cookie windows typically range from 24 hours for Amazon to 30-90 days for other programs.

faq.question: What makes affiliate revenue sustainable for content businesses?
faq.answer: Evergreen content that ranks in search engines generates ongoing affiliate income from continuous organic traffic. Comparison articles, product reviews, and buying guides naturally attract purchase-intent readers who are likely to click affiliate links and convert.
